proves.claim: generatedDocs returns docs/formats/static-view.md rendered whole from the declarations, on a root that has no such file.

cli.io-generated-docs.static-view-render.why: Without it, a regression where the generator needs the committed static view page to render would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: update-docs writes the whole static view page where none exists and --check then passes.

cli.io-generated-docs.static-view-writte.why: Without it, a regression where the static view page is not part of the generated outputs would pass unnoticed.
